real: Stocks slide as US interest rates keep climbing
anon: Stocks slide as the cost of borrowing keeps climbing
note: S&P 500 -2.7% in file. Brady report describes the rising-rate backdrop; exact day trigger not pinned, wording kept general.

real: August trade deficit worse than expected; dollar falls
anon: A big trade gap is worse than expected; the dollar falls
note: Fed essay says mid-October; release was Wed 14 Oct, 8:30am (Commerce Dept, about $15.7bn). Confirm date in second source. S&P -3.0% in file.

real: Reagan speaks out against tax rises Congress is weighing
anon: The president speaks out against proposed tax rises
note: Reagan Library lists 'Statement on Proposed Tax Increases' on 15 Oct. Content summarised from title; checker should read statement.

real: Iranian missile hits a US-flagged tanker off Kuwait
anon: A missile hits a tanker in a war zone at sea
note: Sea Isle City hit 15 Oct (from memory; Reagan's 19 Oct remarks cite the missile attack on a ship wounding Americans). Verify date.

real: Stocks fall hard as options and futures contracts expire
anon: Stocks fall hard on a day when many bets run out
note: Fri 16 Oct 'triple witching' per Fed essay. S&P -5.2% in file.

real: Over the weekend, Baker threatens a weaker dollar
anon: Over the weekend, a top official talks down the dollar
note: Fed essay dates Baker's public threat to the weekend (Sat 17 Oct per essay; TV remarks Sun 18 Oct widely reported). Weekend event goes on next trading day.

real: US warships shell an Iranian platform in the Gulf
anon: Warships shell an oil platform after an attack at sea
note: Reagan Library 19 Oct statement on the reprisal against Iran; Reagan says target was a radar and command tower on the platform. Time of day not verified.

real: Black Monday: stocks fall by a fifth in one day
anon: A fifth of the market's value vanishes in one day
note: S&P 500 -20.5% in file; Dow -22.6% per Fed essay.

real: Trading nearly stalls after the opening bell
anon: Dealing nearly stops soon after the opening bell
note: Fed essay: trading nearly stalls after the opening bell on 20 Oct.

real: Fed says it is ready to supply cash to banks
anon: The central bank says it will keep money flowing
note: Greenspan statement before the open: 'readiness to serve as a source of liquidity'. S&P +5.3% in file.

real: Reagan signs order starting automatic budget cuts
anon: The president orders automatic spending cuts
note: Reagan Library: 'Order on Emergency Deficit Control Measures for Fiscal Year 1988', 20 Oct (preliminary sequester order; final order 20 Nov).

real: Stocks surge for a second day, up more than 9%
anon: Stocks surge for a second day running
note: S&P 500 +9.1% in file, after +5.3% on 20 Oct.

real: Stocks fall almost 4% as the rebound stalls
anon: Stocks tumble again as the bounce runs out of steam
note: S&P 500 -3.9% in file. Fed essay: two sessions after Black Monday regained 57% of the loss.

real: Stocks plunge again, the worst day since Black Monday
anon: Stocks plunge again, the worst day since the crash
note: S&P 500 -8.3% in file; largest fall in the file after 19 Oct. No single event attributed.

real: Reagan announces trade sanctions on Iran
anon: A trade ban on a Middle East oil exporter is announced
note: Reagan Library: 'Statement on Trade Sanctions Against Iran', 26 Oct; executive order signed 29 Oct.

real: White House and Congress open budget deficit talks
anon: Government and lawmakers open talks on the budget gap
note: Reagan statement of 27 Oct: discussions begin that day.

real: Reagan signs order banning imports from Iran
anon: A ban on imports from a Middle East country is signed
note: Executive Order 12613, 29 Oct.

real: Reagan and Gorbachev announce a December summit
anon: Two world powers' leaders agree to meet next month
note: Reagan Library: 'Joint Announcement of the Upcoming Soviet-United States Summit Meeting', 30 Oct.

real: Reagan sets up a task force to study the crash
anon: The president sets up a team to study what went wrong
note: Executive Order 12614, Presidential Task Force on Market Mechanisms (the Brady commission).

real: White House disowns unnamed aides' words on the dollar
anon: The president's team disowns remarks on the dollar
note: White House statement of 10 Nov disavowing anonymous remarks reported that day.

real: Reagan and Congress agree a two-year budget deficit deal
anon: Government and lawmakers agree to cut the budget gap
note: $76bn over two years per White House; announced 20 Nov.

real: Jobs report shows unemployment edging down
anon: The latest job numbers show unemployment edging down
note: November jobs report released Fri 4 Dec; Fitzwater commented on the unemployment rate that day. No figure stated. Verify direction against BLS (Oct 6.0 to Nov 5.8, from memory).

real: Reagan signs the budget deal into law
anon: The president signs the budget deal into law
note: Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1987 and continuing appropriations, signed 22 Dec.

real: Task force delivers its report on the October crash
anon: A government team delivers its report on the crash
note: Brady report dated and handed to Reagan 8 Jan ('this afternoon'); time versus close not verified. S&P -6.8% in file; no cause claimed.

real: SEC staff publish their report on the October crash
anon: A market watchdog's staff publish their crash report
note: Staff report released 2 Feb 1988 per Chairman Ruder's 3 Feb testimony.

real: Reagan presents next year's budget to Congress
anon: The president presents next year's budget to lawmakers
note: Reagan Library: remarks presenting FY1989 budget, 18 Feb.

real: Reagan sends Congress the annual report on the economy
anon: The president sends lawmakers a yearly economy report
note: Annual Economic Report of the President, 19 Feb.

real: Reagan creates a working group on financial markets
anon: The president sets up a group to watch the markets
note: Executive Order 12631, 18 Mar.

real: February trade deficit widens; stocks fall sharply
anon: The trade gap widens more than expected; stocks drop
note: Deficit $13.8bn per contemporary reports (not stated in line). S&P -4.4% in file. After fall end, so not big.

real: After Tuesday's close, Fed raises its bank lending rate
anon: The central bank raises the rate it charges banks
note: Discount rate 6% to 6.5%, approved Tue 9 Aug 1988; announcement time versus close not verified.

real: George Bush wins the presidential election
anon: Voters pick a new president
note: Election day 8 Nov 1988; result known that evening, after the close.
